title: Roltek observability configuration
description: Monitors, status components, SLOs, alert routes, silence templates, alert ingest integrations (metadata only), alert dependencies and incident update templates, as one reviewable document. Every resource has a stable `key`; references name keys, never ids. Secret values are references ({"fromEnv": "NAME"} or {"fromFile": "path"}) the CLI resolves; ingest keys and heartbeat tokens are never part of a file. Per-field rules, unique keys, resolvable references and loop-free dependencies are enforced by the server and the CLI and reported with a path and a message.
